title: Money through a zoned field and a float
prompt: AMTCVT.rpgle moves money through a float and a zoned field with the wrong precision, so the cents drift and a value too large is truncated silently. Fix it: keep every monetary value packed with the precision the field needs, size the intermediate so a product cannot overflow, and handle the conversion failure with a MONITOR group instead of letting it end the program. Say in a comment what the precision of each value is and why.
check: ! codeonly AMTCVT.rpgle | grep -qiE 'float|\bfloat8\b|\bfloat4\b' && [ $(codeonly AMTCVT.rpgle | grep -ciE 'packed\(') -ge 3 ] && ! codeonly AMTCVT.rpgle | grep -qiE 'zoned\( *11 *: *0 *\)' && codeonly AMTCVT.rpgle | grep -qi 'monitor;' && codeonly AMTCVT.rpgle | grep -qi 'on-error' && codeonly AMTCVT.rpgle | grep -qiE 'packed\( *1[5-9] *:' && grep -qE '^ *//' AMTCVT.rpgle
